what_routing_means_here: Recipe-estate item: the routing simulated is the card widget's store-cell selection (cheapestAcross, first minimum wins) per ingredient line, per lane (cheapest / everyday), per serving count (14 = base, 28), BEFORE (data-block gpu = gross grams per feed unit, as built today) and AFTER (gpu_eff = pkg_g / (buy_pkg_g / gpu), drained grams per feed unit). The outcome recorded per line is the winning store, its package basis, the package count k and the cost. engine_k is ceil(grams/pkg_g - 0.02), the static cost line's Buy N.
